tools.name: search_adverts
tools.description: Search listings on the marketplace. Results never include seller contacts. Show a listing only with the photos that search_adverts or get_advert returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. If it has no photo, show no image. To show the user photos, call show_

tools.name: reveal_contact
tools.description: Seller's phone, WhatsApp or chat link. Call only when the user asks to contact the seller. Call it for the one listing the user asked to contact; never reveal contacts for several listings at once or to compile a list of contacts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Marketplace categories, one level at a time. Use category_id in search_adverts.

tools.name: get_category_filters
tools.description: Filters available in a category (brand, model, year, storage...) for search_adverts.attributes.

tools.name: show_listings
tools.description: Show listings and new developments to the user as cards with their own photos, price, location and a link to the site. Pass ids from search or details results, up to 10 in total. No contacts.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_adverts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
